title: Synthetic customer retrieval migration exercise
description: A deliberately fictional breaking change used to test deterministic matching. This is not an actual Stripe advisory.
oldBehavior: In this fictional scenario, customer retrieval returns the customer directly.
newBehavior: In this fictional scenario, customer retrieval returns a customer inside a result wrapper.
migrationInstructions: Review each matched retrieval call and its consumers against the fictional wrapper contract.
Do not apply this fictional migration to a real Stripe integration.
